impact: A broad China slowdown weighs on global demand, commodities and Asian exporters; weaker Chinese demand is a headwind for memory and handset chips (MU, DRAM) and Korean names like SKM, though it may add pressure on Beijing to stimulate households.
summary: China's retail sales rose 0.4% y/y in October vs 0.8% expected (1.1% in September) despite the National Day holiday. Industrial output grew 4.8% vs 5.3% expected, and fixed-asset investment fell 8.1% year to date, worse than the roughly 7% drop forecast, with property investment down over 21%. Unemployment edged down to 5.1%.
title: China October data misses: retail sales +0.4%, output +4.8%, investment -8.1%
